title: The Words of the Covenant
reflectionText: The commands join worship with work, rest, harvest, and the firstborn. Moses remains with Yahweh while the words of the covenant are written. What draws your attention among these particular commands, as the call to worship no other god reaches into the rhythms of Israel’s life?
editorialNotes: Packet 047 initial writer output; adult Traditional Short only. Each lane follows its respective bundled Bible source. Numbered Scripture artifacts preserve the exact source verses. The opening identifies Yahweh/the Lord as speaker and Moses as recipient. Commands remain commands.
